content:
Just a heads up that I have begun the process of upstreaming the Wiener-Ikehara theorem (and the WeakPNT) corollary) to Mathlib. This will take some time: the 2700+ lines of code in PNT+ needed to get to WeakPNT was not designed with Mathlib upstreamability in mind. Initially I am proceeding by identifying pieces of the proof that are independently upstreamable and PR'ing those: see #42932 #42933 #42953. This (together with some identification of redundancy of old code with new Mathlib additions) has already reduced the remaining amount of code to upstream to about 2200 lines of code, but there is clearly still a ways to go. Will post updates when there is more to report. (In the unlikely chance that anyone is interested in the process, the draft code is at https://github.com/teorth/mathlib4/tree/wiener-ikehara .)

UPDATE: now down to 1674 lines, as my coding agent has identified a redundancy in the summability of a certain function fun n ↦ ‖f n‖ / n * (C / (1 + (log (n / x) / (2 * π)) ^ 2)), and a bound on its value, were proven separately using two different proofs, but the agent was able to find a common proof which established both.

Update: Now at 1288 lines. A large part of prior code was devoted to showing that a Schwartz function could be approximated in W^{2,1} norm by a test function. The more useful statement that test functions are in fact dense in Schwartz space has now been spun off at #43046, and all the W^{2,1} material could then be removed.
